pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding positions into falling or rising knives; pyramiding is authorized only after the initial position has achieved a locked-in breakeven + trailing stop state.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero execution within +/- 5 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic news releases and require an institutional volume/order-flow confirmation delta before placement.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops and partial profit scaling once floating profit reaches $15.00 to prevent evaporation toward negative outcomes.
